messages:
alex: Heads up — CI run for eval-harness v2 leaked raw prompts into shared artifacts bucket. Found full customer prompt payloads at s3://redwood-evals-artifacts/global/2026-03-01/runner-9876/prompts.json :warning:

marta: who ran that job? repro steps?

devin: I triggered it during the quantization eval sweep. Quick repro:
```
$ make ci-eval TARGET=model-x-qt
# logs
Uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-evals-artifacts/global/2026-03-01/runner-9876/
artifacts/prompts.json (contains raw prompts)
```

nisha: omg. That file has unredacted customer prompts? :lock: We need immediate mitigation: restrict bucket access + redact before upload. Also check who has read perms (lots of analytics roles currently).

kyle: root cause looks like artifact_uploader in eval-runner doesn't apply the redact filter when RUN_MODE=="ci" — it only runs in local/hosted flows. There's an env var override EVAL_ARTIFACT_BUCKET that CI uses; uploader trusts bucket value blindly.

anya: can someone paste the uploader snippet? I can add validation + unit test.

devin: snippet incoming:
```
# eval_runner/uploader.py
if os.getenv("EVAL_ARTIFACT_BUCKET"):
    bucket = os.getenv("EVAL_ARTIFACT_BUCKET")
# ... upload_json(path, bucket)
```
No check for allowed buckets or redaction flag.

nisha: Proposed short-term remediation (hotfix):
- Block CI from using global bucket. Create ci-only bucket with strict ACLs: s3://redwood-evals-ci-temp
- Add pre-upload sanitizer that redacts PII (email, SSN, credit card) and hashes customer ids
- Enforce KMS encryption and require requester-pays disabled

marta: longer-term: uploader should validate bucket against a whitelist and the codepath should run redact step regardless of environment. Also we should never write raw prompts to permanent storage unless explicitly approved (opt-in).

kyle: agreed. Implementation plan:
1) add ALLOWED_ARTIFACT_BUCKETS env var (comma separated)
2) uploader raises if bucket not in ALLOWED_ARTIFACT_BUCKETS
3) always run sanitizer unless ARTIFACT_PRESERVE=true and a feature-flag audit approval present
4) CI job should set ALLOWED_ARTIFACT_BUCKETS to only the ci-temp bucket

devin: I'll open a patch with unit tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/412 (draft)

anya: I'll own the sanitizer. Plan for sanitizer:
- regex-based scrub for obvious PII (emails, phone, SSN patterns)
- prompt-level token redaction for top-k sensitive tokens using model-assisted detector
- add a summary-only artifact with counts and hashes

nisha: please add an automated eval to the security job that runs a prompt leak detector on artifacts after CI completes. If any artifact contains sequences matching our PII regex, fail CI and notify security channel.

eval-ci-bot: CI check: artifact-leak-detector found 1 artifact with potential PII. Failing job and quarantining artifacts. See: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/5643 :rotating_light:

kyle: unit test name suggestion: tests/test_artifact_isolation.py -> checks that artifacts never contain unredacted prompts and that bucket validation rejects global bucket.

devin: tests added in PR (draft). Patch diff:
```
+def test_bucket_whitelist(tmp_env):
+    setenv("ALLOWED_ARTIFACT_BUCKETS", "redwood-evals-ci-temp")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        uploader.upload_json(..., bucket="redwood-evals-artifacts")
```

marta: dashboard/reporting note: our eval reporting pipeline currently picks up artifacts for metric recompute. We need to change the pipeline to read only "summary.json" and never ingest raw prompt files. Update the ingestion lambda and add a validator to refuse raw prompt ingestion.

anya: adding summary.json output in sanitizer + updating dashboard ingestion. Will add shim to the transform:
```
if artifact.name.endswith("prompts.json"):
    raise IngestError("raw prompt ingestion blocked")
```

nisha: also audit ACLs: run `aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket redwood-evals-artifacts` and ensure only service principals still needed have read. I can run a one-off and share results.

alex: thanks all. Action items:
- devin: finalize PR with tests and whitelist checks (ETA: EOD)
- anya: implement sanitizer + summary.json and update dashboard ingestion (ETA: 48h)
- nisha: run ACL audit and propose bucket policy changes (ETA: 24h)
- kyle: help land unit tests and coordinate CI change to point to ci-temp bucket

devin: PR updated to include tests and a CI job that fails on leak detector. Marking ready for review.

eval-ci-bot: Pipeline: evals-ci #5643 - artifact-leak-detector: PASS :white_check_mark:

marta: closing loop — once PRs merged we'll rotate the global bucket credentials and remove broad read perms. Also start a brief incident report for compliance.

alex: nice triage. Please ping infra and compliance when rotating creds. :thumbsup:
